facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: near hit - electrical exposure at P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next spot check that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on P-3222 and PT-3222 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during shift handover while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 8 December 2009 a near hit was recorded on P-3222 and PT-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
